title: Consent record
description: Append-only proof of what the user was shown and agreed to, written at acceptance (server clock) before any LLM processing (scope intake) or before anything is kept (scope keep_for_improvement). No conversation content, no contact details. The integrity HMAC was cut (critic F12: it proves nothing to a third party); the texts themselves are versioned in git. Draft 3.3 (gate 1): D-13 branch B puts the age statement inside consent.checkbox@v3, recorded as age_declaration + age_declaration_text on every intake-scope record; D-01b adds the separate opt-in scope keep_for_improvement, which carries the kept record's id and NO session_id (no link from a kept conversation back to its session, lead or metrics).

session_id.description: Required for every scope except keep_for_improvement, where it is forbidden (D-01b: no linking id).

scope.description: intake = disclaimer + processing + the age statement (required to start). intake_health_data = only if the lawyer requires a separate box. handoff = sending summary + contact to Hadas. keep_for_improvement (D-01b, draft 3.3) = the optional, never pre-checked, unconditional end-of-conversation box: the conversation is kept, names masked by reasonable effort, no contact details, 180 days from this record's 'at', then purged automatically (D-01b': no withdrawal code). Written by DELETE /api/intake/session only when keep_offer_eligible is true on the server (ARCHITECTURE §11.1.1).

sha256.description: Hash of the exact rendered string (variant for the channel, placeholders filled).

texts_shown.description: Every text of the screen the user accepted on, as rendered (L-09/L-14). Web intake scope = the full S1 set returned by GET /bootstrap: intro.greeting, page.tool.not_this, page.tool.steps, consent.title, consent.disclaimer, consent.emergency, consent.checkbox (and the active consent.checkbox.* alternative if the lawyer requires two boxes). The server rejects (409) a consent whose set differs from the bootstrap set.

kept_id.description: keep_for_improvement only: the random id of the record in intake-kept (kept-conversation.schema.json). Not derived from session_id, lead_id or metrics_id.

age_declaration.description: D-13 branch B (draft 3.3): the user declared, inside the consent checkbox text, 'over 18, or a parent writing about their child'. Required on scope intake. There are no age buttons; self_declared_minor detection on free text still runs every turn.

id.description: consent.checkbox (one box), or consent.checkbox.ack if the lawyer requires two boxes.

age_declaration_text.description: Which text carried the age statement, at which version. Equal to the matching texts_shown entry (server invariant, unit-tested). consent.checkbox carries it from v3.

allOf.description: Every scope except keep_for_improvement belongs to one session; it never names a kept record.
D-01b: the keep consent has no session_id (no link back), names its kept record, is web-only in v1, a checkbox, and records both keep texts.
D-13 branch B: the intake consent records the age statement and the checkbox text that carried it, and that text was shown.
consent.checkbox carries the age statement from v3 (D-13 branch B); an older version cannot be the evidence.
age_declaration and its text travel together.
